comments.author: Yaknow
comments.body:
seize cargo fires off often, giving you mulitple opportunities to plunder an individual ship, not just when you defeat them. Ambush makes each plunder attempt more likely to be a 'rare' drop instead of the common drop.

Either one of these skills by themselves are more desirable than a simple +1 to plunder, put them together and it's magic.

comments.author: Aguirre
comments.body: I am looking to add another aid and, as an avid plunderer, this skill is intriguing. The issue I am having is that the aide must be in the lookout duty to use the skill and, if successful, will continue to be in when battle starts. Unfortunately, there are not a lot of aide skills that are useful in combat that also require lookout, which essentially makes these aides a "one-trick-pony." Natascha has evasion, which would be helpful but requires levels 35 and 36, respectively, meaning a long grind to get them. Just wondering what other folks' experiences are? Is the skill worth it? Is there a better aide? Am I overlooking something? Thanks.
